statement: Every New Zealand company must file an annual return with the Companies Office each year during its allocated filing month (assigned at incorporation), confirming that the information on the Companies Register is correct and paying the $49.74-plus-GST fee; the annual return is a public record of company information, not a financial document, and the Registrar may remove a company that does not complete it on time from the register.
caveat: Companies incorporated in the current calendar year generally do not file until the following year, and the fee changes with Companies Office fee reviews; the duty sits in Companies Act 1993 s 214 (legislation.govt.nz answers automated fetches with an AWS WAF challenge, recorded 2026-10-23). Check the live guidance for the current fee and your filing month.
